cards.back:
The natural home of an animal or plant.
Bahasa Indonesia: habitat (tempat hidup alami)
Example: The forest is the habitat of many birds.
cards.say: habitat. The natural home of an animal or plant. The forest is the habitat of many birds.

cards.back:
Living in nature, not looked after by people.
Bahasa Indonesia: liar
Example: A wild elephant walked past our car.
cards.say: wild. Living in nature, not looked after by people. A wild elephant walked past our car.

cards.back:
An animal that you keep at home.
Bahasa Indonesia: hewan peliharaan
Example: My pet cat sleeps on my bed.
cards.say: pet. An animal that you keep at home. My pet cat sleeps on my bed.

cards.back:
A small animal with six legs.
Bahasa Indonesia: serangga
Example: An insect landed on my hand.
cards.say: insect. A small animal with six legs. An insect landed on my hand.

cards.back:
A cold-blooded animal with dry, scaly skin, like a snake.
Bahasa Indonesia: reptil
Example: A lizard is a kind of reptile.
cards.say: reptile. A cold-blooded animal with dry, scaly skin, like a snake. A lizard is a kind of reptile.

cards.back:
An animal that feeds its babies with milk.
Bahasa Indonesia: mamalia
Example: A whale is a mammal, not a fish.
cards.say: mammal. An animal that feeds its babies with milk. A whale is a mammal, not a fish.

cards.back:
The part at the back of an animal's body.
Bahasa Indonesia: ekor
Example: The dog wagged its tail happily.
cards.say: tail. The part at the back of an animal's body. The dog wagged its tail happily.

cards.back:
The part of a bird or insect used for flying.
Bahasa Indonesia: sayap
Example: The bird opened its wings and flew away.
cards.say: wing. The part of a bird or insect used for flying. The bird opened its wings and flew away.

cards.back:
One of the light parts that cover a bird.
Bahasa Indonesia: bulu burung
Example: I found a white feather on the grass.
cards.say: feather. One of the light parts that cover a bird. I found a white feather on the grass.

cards.back:
The soft hair that covers some animals.
Bahasa Indonesia: bulu (hewan berbulu)
Example: The rabbit has very soft fur.
cards.say: fur. The soft hair that covers some animals. The rabbit has very soft fur.

cards.back:
A hard cover that protects some animals.
Bahasa Indonesia: cangkang
Example: The snail hid inside its shell.
cards.say: shell. A hard cover that protects some animals. The snail hid inside its shell.

cards.back:
The foot of an animal like a cat or dog.
Bahasa Indonesia: kaki hewan (telapak kaki)
Example: The kitten put its paw in the water.
cards.say: paw. The foot of an animal like a cat or dog. The kitten put its paw in the water.

cards.back:
A sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot.
Bahasa Indonesia: cakar
Example: The eagle caught a fish with its claws.
cards.say: claw. A sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot. The eagle caught a fish with its claws.

cards.back:
The hard mouth of a bird.
Bahasa Indonesia: paruh
Example: The duck dug in the mud with its beak.
cards.say: beak. The hard mouth of a bird. The duck dug in the mud with its beak.

cards.back:
The small, hard flat parts that cover a fish or snake.
Bahasa Indonesia: sisik
Example: Fish have shiny scales on their bodies.
cards.say: scales. The small, hard flat parts that cover a fish or snake. Fish have shiny scales on their bodies.

cards.back:
A home that a bird builds for its eggs.
Bahasa Indonesia: sarang
Example: The bird built a nest in the tree.
cards.say: nest. A home that a bird builds for its eggs. The bird built a nest in the tree.

cards.back:
A place where people grow food and keep animals.
Bahasa Indonesia: pertanian, peternakan
Example: We saw cows and sheep on the farm.
cards.say: farm. A place where people grow food and keep animals. We saw cows and sheep on the farm.

cards.back:
A place where people can see wild animals.
Bahasa Indonesia: kebun binatang
Example: We saw a tiger at the zoo.
cards.say: zoo. A place where people can see wild animals. We saw a tiger at the zoo.

cards.back:
A large reptile with big teeth that lives in rivers and swamps.
Bahasa Indonesia: buaya
Example: A crocodile lay still in the river.
cards.say: crocodile. A large reptile with big teeth that lives in rivers and swamps. A crocodile lay still in the river.

cards.back:
A clever sea mammal that jumps out of the water.
Bahasa Indonesia: lumba-lumba
Example: The dolphin jumped through the hoop.
cards.say: dolphin. A clever sea mammal that jumps out of the water. The dolphin jumped through the hoop.

cards.back:
An Australian animal that hops and carries its baby in a pouch.
Bahasa Indonesia: kanguru
Example: The kangaroo hopped across the field.
cards.say: kangaroo. An Australian animal that hops and carries its baby in a pouch. The kangaroo hopped across the field.

cards.back:
A black and white bird that swims but cannot fly.
Bahasa Indonesia: pinguin
Example: The penguin slid on the ice.
cards.say: penguin. A black and white bird that swims but cannot fly. The penguin slid on the ice.

cards.back:
An insect with big, colourful wings.
Bahasa Indonesia: kupu-kupu
Example: A yellow butterfly sat on the flower.
cards.say: butterfly. An insect with big, colourful wings. A yellow butterfly sat on the flower.

cards.back:
A small animal with eight legs that makes webs.
Bahasa Indonesia: laba-laba
Example: The spider made a web in the corner.
cards.say: spider. A small animal with eight legs that makes webs. The spider made a web in the corner.
